props.name: actionsRef
props.documentation:
A ref to imperative actions.
- `unmount`: When specified, the dialog will not be unmounted when closed.
Instead, the `unmount` function must be called to unmount the dialog manually.
Useful when the dialog's animation is controlled by an external library.

props.name: children
props.documentation:
The content of the dialog.
This can be a regular React node or a render function that receives the `payload` of the active trigger.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.documentation:
Whether the dialog is initially open.

To render a controlled dialog, use the `open` prop instead.

props.name: defaultTriggerId
props.documentation:
ID of the trigger that the dialog is associated with.
This is useful in conjunction with the `defaultOpen` prop to create an initially open dialog.

props.name: handle
props.documentation:
A handle to associate the popover with a trigger.
If specified, allows external triggers to control the popover's open state.
Can be created with the AlertDialog.createHandle() method.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.documentation: Event handler called when the dialog is opened or closed.

props.name: onOpenChangeComplete
props.documentation: Event handler called after any animations complete when the dialog is opened or closed.

props.name: open
props.documentation: Whether the dialog is currently open.

props.name: triggerId
props.documentation:
ID of the trigger that the dialog is associated with.
This is useful in conjuntion with the `open` prop to create a controlled dialog.
There's no need to specify this prop when the popover is uncontrolled (i.e. when the `open` prop is not set).
